name: Pasta
intro: Cherry tomatoes burst in olive oil until they become the sauce. Halibut flaked in, or nothing at all.

proteins.name: Halibut
proteins.timing: Seared first in the same pan, 3–4 minutes, flipped, 1–2 more. Flaked in at the end.

proteins.name: No protein
proteins.timing: Burst tomatoes and basil on their own.

steps.text: Bring a big pot of well-salted water to a boil and cook the pasta.
Halibut: sear it in a wide pan with a little oil, flip once, and set it aside.
In the same pan, warm the oil and garlic over medium for a minute, then add the tomatoes.
Cook until they split and slump, pressing a few with a spoon to release their juice.
Save a mug of pasta water, drain, and toss the pasta in the pan with a splash of it. Flake in the fish.

leftovers: Better fresh. If there's extra, it's a cold lunch with a squeeze of lime.
